title: Ratty – A terminal emulator with inline 3D graphics
summary: Ratty is a terminal emulator application that supports rendering inline 3D graphics directly within the terminal environment, combining traditional command-line interface functionality with modern 3D visualization capabilities.
problem_solved: Enables users to display and interact with 3D graphics content directly within a terminal emulator without needing separate graphical applications.
why_valuable: Provides seamless integration of 3D visualization into developer workflows, allowing for inline graphics display in CLI tools, data visualization, and interactive terminal-based applications.
